name: Reggaeton
description: A reggaeton singer, a woman in her late twenties with effortless swagger, cool and unhurried, owning the stage without trying.
build: A slim, athletic adult woman of ordinary proportions: medium shoulders, a defined waist, curvy hips, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with relaxed knees.
face: Warm golden-tan skin, dark brown almond eyes under bold arched black brows, high cheekbones, a small straight nose, full lips with deep berry-red lipstick, and white teeth.
hair: Long sleek jet-black hair pulled up into a high ponytail that falls in a thick glossy mass to the shoulder blades, with smooth edges at the hairline.
outfit: An oversized cropped bright lemon-yellow hoodie, sleeves pushed to the elbows so both forearms and hands are bare, over a black sports bra top; loose black track pants with one wide bold white stripe down each outer leg; chunky white sneakers. Large bold gold hoop earrings as wide as her palm, and a thick gold chain necklace. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Hip cocked: weight on the character-left leg, the character-right foot turned out. The character-right hand rests open on the character-right hip, the character-left arm hangs loose, hand open and empty. Head tipped slightly, cool half-lidded look.
location: A night-time rooftop party in a warm Caribbean city: a concrete roof running to the bottom of the frame, a low parapet with strings of warm bulbs, palm silhouettes and lit apartment blocks beyond under a deep blue sky.
recognition_cues: black track pants with a wide white stripe
palette: sports bra and track pants black #1D1C21 / #0C0B0E / #3A3842
avoid: a hand in the hoodie pocket

sing.intent: Reggaeton vocal loop: rock the hips side to side on the beat, hold the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, roll the open character-left hand in a lazy circle at shoulder height, then drop the mic to the chest and settle back into the cocked-hip stance. The mouth must visibly open wide and change shape across the loop so the singing reads unmistakably.

animations.flinch: A quick startle at a loud room sound: the shoulders tighten and the head pulls back, both open hands lift a little, then she shrugs it off and returns to the cocked-hip stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: square the feet, bring the character-left forearm up across the chest, character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a cool steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with a slow rolling walk, tug the ponytail with the character-left hand, then land in the cocked-hip stance with the character-right hand on the hip.
